name: openmi
description: OpenMi — mobile-first, serverless vibe-coding agent that commits to your GitHub repo.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.check:node: node --import tsx -e "import('./api/index.ts').then((m) => { if (typeof m.default !== 'function') throw new Error('Vercel handler is not a function'); console.log('vercel handler: ok'); })"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:node && npm run check:bundle
